title: macOS 27 Golden Gate review: addresses many Tahoe-era Liquid Glass issues and has useful new AI features, but no Intel support and uses a lot of storage space (Andrew Cunningham/Ars Technica)
summary: Andrew Cunningham / Ars Technica: macOS 27 Golden Gate review: addresses many Tahoe-era Liquid Glass issues and has useful new AI features, but no Intel support and uses a lot of storage space — It's both a “Snow Leopard update” and a major leap for Apple Intelligence. — Apple Intelligence is back, baby!
contentText:
Andrew Cunningham / Ars Technica :

macOS 27 Golden Gate review: addresses many Tahoe-era Liquid Glass issues and has useful new AI features, but no Intel support and uses a lot of storage space   —  It's both a “Snow Leopard update” and a major leap for Apple Intelligence.  —  Apple Intelligence is back, baby!
